hypotheses.H1_semantic_spikes: Whitened trace-centered semantic forms have median max-eigenvalue/null ratio above 1.2 and exceed their matched SAE-feature controls by at least 0.1.
hypotheses.H2_cross_seed_subspaces: Same-category top-4 eigenspaces across SAE seeds have median overlap above 0.02 and at least three times the mismatched-category median.
hypotheses.H3_semantic_reconstruction: Across categories and three held-out corpora, the top-4 approximation has median oriented AUROC at least 0.70 and loses no more than 0.05 AUROC relative to the full quadratic form.
hypotheses.H4_causal_spikes: For at least four of five semantic directions, median spike-only downstream effect fidelity exceeds bulk-only fidelity, and the overall semantic spike median exceeds 0.30.
hypotheses.H5_semantic_control_advantage: Median semantic spike-only causal fidelity exceeds matched-control fidelity by at least 0.10.
